conversion_rule: DOA->Tekken federation: P->1/2 alternating, K->3/4 alternating, numpad 8/2/4/6/9/7/3/1 -> u/d/b/f/u\/f/u\/b/d\/f/d\/b, 66->f,f, 236->qcf, 214->qcb, F+P(throw)->1+3, F+dir(hold)->1+2, F+K/P+K->1+2 (strike). Same-input collisions get a ~suffix on the dict key only; entry.input keeps the true Tekken input.
doa_source: DOA4 command list — deadoralive.fandom.com/wiki/Leifang/Dead_or_Alive_4_command_list (community movelist). Worker 59 federation conversion (DOA notation -> Tekken inputs).
frame_convention: DOA4 60fps -> seconds. Per-move damage/frames are NOT published in the source; all damage + frames estimated from move archetype and flagged per honesty rule. WH 100HP scale.
